_readme: Optional background music. Leave 'tracks' empty to use the tune composed live in the browser (public/atlas/music.js). To use real recordings, copy the audio files into this folder and list them: { "title": "Name", "file": "name.mp3", "credit": "who made it", "license": "public domain / CC0 / CC BY ..." }. Only use music you have the right to use. One track loops; several play in order. To try a single file without editing this: add ?track=name.mp3 (a file in this folder) or ?track=https://... to the Atlas address.
